summary: The shared foundation is small and functional: a 53-line globals.css with a Tailwind 4 @theme token block, a root layout loading Syne via next/font with a working skip link, a fixed blurred Nav (4 links + Start a Project, hamburger under 768px), a 3-column Footer, and a PageShell used by all internal pages. All 10 routes and every nav/footer link return HTTP 200, there is no sideways scroll at 360/390/768/1024/1440, and focus rings are present. What is missing is the finishing layer: the tokens are declared but never used (320 hard-coded hex literals in components), there is no favicon/OG/robots/sitemap (public/ is empty), no custom 404, and the mobile menu has no Escape, scroll-lock, focus containment or overflow handling. The nav also degrades visibly over the light sections. Test scripts and screenshots are in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (foundation-test.mjs, foundation-test2.mjs, foundation-*.png).
keep: Wordmark treatment (MAKEND + prism-gradient LESS, wide tracking) in nav and footer - distinctive and consistent; keep exactly.
Syne-only font loading via next/font with display swap (layout.tsx:6); document.fonts confirms only Syne 400-800 plus its fallback is loaded on shipped pages.
Skip link (layout.tsx:18): first Tab stop, clearly visible white pill with cyan ring (tmp/foundation-skiplink-1440.png), and activating it moves the tab sequence past the header into main.
Global :focus-visible rule (globals.css:26) - 2px #22d3ee outline with 3px offset applies to every link/button; clearly visible on dark surfaces (tmp/foundation-footer-focus.png).
Global prefers-reduced-motion block (globals.css:34-36); computed scroll-behavior switches to auto under reduced motion.
Hamburger button: 44x44, correct aria-expanded / aria-controls / aria-label toggling ('Open menu'/'Close menu'), animated icon; mobile menu rows are 61px tall and the CTA 52px - comfortable targets.
Mobile menu closes on link tap and on wordmark tap, and unmounts cleanly when resized to desktop.

All nav and footer links resolve: /, /studios, /about, /faq, /contact, /create, /build, /grow, /privacy, /terms all HTTP 200; footer contains exactly the spec list including 'GROW — Beta'; no invented contact details.
Footer structure: three labelled <nav> groups with headings, honest copyright line, CREATE • BUILD • GROW tagline.
Per-page titles via the '%s — MAKENDLESS' template; exactly one h1 and one main per page; html lang='en'; themeColor set.
No horizontal overflow at 360/390/768/820/1024/1440 (scrollWidth == viewport); desktop nav fits at 768 without wrapping (tmp/foundation-nav-768.png).
PageShell dark hero band + light/dark body pattern with eyebrow/h1/intro - a sound reusable base; 'Explore Studios' anchor lands with the heading 160px below the fixed nav (not hidden).
ownerTodos: Production domain (needed for metadataBase, canonical URLs, sitemap and Open Graph URLs) - must not be invented.
Approve a favicon / app-icon mark (e.g. 'M' monogram or the prism 'LESS' fragment) and the social share (Open Graph) image design.
Approve 404 page wording.
Decide whether the primary nav keeps both 'Contact' and 'Start a Project' (same destination) or drops the text link.

confirmed.title: HTML screens are not occluded by 3D bodies: phone screen shows through the laptop

The auditor's docs/audit/tmp/hero-1440-web-zoom.png clearly shows the phone screen drawn over the laptop lid and deck. confirmed.title: Auto-cycling modes cannot be paused by the Pause button, hover or keyboard focus

confirmed.fix: Make the pause button also call setCycling(false), and stop cycling on focusin or pointerenter within the dock and scene. Consider relabelling it 'Pause demo'.
confirmed.note: Reproduced on fresh loads: after clicking Pause (aria-pressed=true, label Play video) the selected tab went from Video Editing to Digital Marketing within 7.5s; with focus on the selected tab it changed to Website Development; with the mouse resting on the scene it also changed. confirmed.title: Pause button is a no-op or misleading in several states

summary: The /contact page is a generic PageShell (eyebrow + H1 + intro) followed by a bare four-field form (Name, Email, service select, message) in components/ContactForm.tsx (49 lines). Client validation works and the no-backend result is literally honest (no network request, text says "was not sent anywhere"), but there is no loading state, no real error state, no usable success path, and the result panel shows developer text (an env var name) to the visitor and dead-ends them. Query-string preselection only half works (?service= maps to the studio, package name is dropped; ?for= does nothing at all), the H1 causes sideways scrolling at 360 and 390, and the form is absent from the server HTML. Visually it is the weakest, most template-looking page on the site: a single narrow column on a flat dark background with a 160px dead gap above it.
keep: Honesty baseline: with no NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL, a valid submit makes zero non-GET requests (measured) and the panel explicitly says the message 'was not sent anywhere'. No false 'sent' message. Keep that principle, rewrite the wording.

The validation rules and friendly error copy ('Please tell us your name.', 'Enter a valid email address.', 'Tell us a little more (at least 10 characters).') and the noValidate + custom-message approach.
aria-invalid toggles correctly per field and aria-describedby points at the error span once it exists (name/email/message).
Every control is wrapped in a <label>, so all four have accessible names; autocomplete=name/email are set; email input is type=email.
Keyboard: logical tab order (skip link, nav, name, email, select, textarea, button), Enter in an input submits, and all controls show the 2px #22d3ee focus-visible outline (globals.css:26).
Touch sizing: inputs 54px, select 51px, button 56px tall; 16px input font size so iOS does not zoom on focus; full-width submit button on mobile.
Syne is applied to inputs, select and labels (computed font-family verified); one H1; page title 'Start a Project — MAKENDLESS'.
Spec copy is used verbatim: 'Let's make something worth remembering.' / 'Tell us what you're building. We'll help you take the next step.'
GROW option is honestly labelled 'GROW — Digital marketing (beta interest)'.
?service=create|build|grow (and create-starter etc.) correctly preselects the studio in the select.
No invented contact details, response times or policies anywhere on the page.
ownerTodos: Approve a delivery channel for the form (inbox address or form backend). Until then the form must keep saying nothing was sent.
Decide whether an email address may be shown publicly on the contact page (currently none, per 'no invented contact details').
Decide whether to ask for budget at all, and if so whether as free text only (no price brackets can be shown since no prices are approved).
Decide whether phone / WhatsApp may be offered as a preferred contact method.
Approve the wording for what happens after a brief is received (no response-time promise can be written without owner sign-off).
Confirm the privacy/consent sentence to show next to the submit button and that /privacy covers form data.

confirmed.title: Result panel shows developer text to the visitor and is a dead end
confirmed.evidence: After a valid submit the form is replaced by: 'Form checked. Delivery channel pending. The inquiry inbox isn't connected yet, so this message was not sent anywhere. The team needs to set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL or a form backend before launch.' It is honest, but it exposes an environment variable name to customers, discards everything the visitor typed (form unmounted, no state kept), and the panel contains 0 links/buttons (measured: resultDom.links = 0) - no way back to the form, no copy of the brief, no next step. The spec asks for a fully built success state AND an honest one; this is a developer placeholder, not a designed state.
confirmed.fix: Keep the honesty, redesign the state for a customer: a designed 'Your brief is ready - but not sent' panel that shows a readable summary of what they entered, a 'Copy brief' button (clipboard), an 'Edit brief' button that restores the form with values intact, and plain wording such as 'Online sending isn't switched on yet, so nothing has been sent.' Remove the env var name from user-facing copy (keep it in README/TODO-FOR-OWNER). Build the real success state ('Brief received') behind a delivery flag so it can never render while no delivery service is configured.
confirmed.note: Reproduced at 1440 with a valid submit (docs/audit/tmp/verify-contact-1440-result.png). Panel text is exactly as quoted, including NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL; it contains 0 links/buttons, the form is unmounted, and focus drops to BODY. ContactForm.tsx:31-37. The wording is honest (no false 'sent'), so the blocker is the customer-facing developer copy and the dead end, not dishonesty.

confirmed.title: No loading state and no submission-error state exist
confirmed.evidence: State is just err + done. Submit to result took 69ms with no pending UI; the button never disables or changes label; there is no code path for a failed delivery (no try/catch, no error panel, no retry). Spec: 'Fully built: fields, validation, loading, success and error states.'
confirmed.fix: Model status as idle | validating/submitting | success | not-delivered | error. Add a submit adapter (single function returning ok / not-configured / failed) with no service wired. While pending: disable the button, aria-busy on the form, label 'Checking your brief...'. Error state: role=alert panel with the visitor's data preserved and a Retry button. Not-configured maps to the honest 'not sent' panel; success is only reachable when the adapter reports real delivery.
confirmed.note: ContactForm.tsx:11-12 holds only err and done. Measured Enter-to-result at 58ms with no pending UI; there is no try/catch, failure path or retry. The spec line 'validation, loading, success and error states' is not met. A genuine loading state only matters once an adapter exists, but the states are required to be built now.

(Side effect seen in testing: the widened layout viewport offsets the visual viewport, so coordinate taps landed 64px off.)

The auditor omitted 320, which is also broken.

confirmed.title: Form is too thin for a real project brief
confirmed.where: components/ContactForm.tsx:42-46 (fields: name, email, service, message only)
confirmed.evidence: DOM field list is exactly [name, email, service, message]. Nothing captures who the customer is, which package, project type, existing links, timing or budget, so every inquiry would need a follow-up round. No field is marked required or optional (0 elements with required/aria-required), and there is no helper text or placeholder guidance on the message box.
confirmed.fix: Add, without inventing any policy or figure: (1) Customer type (four spec types + other); (2) Package / service detail driven by data/site.ts (V1-V5, T1-T5, M1-M3 as multi-select chips per studio); (3) Business or channel name (optional); (4) Links - current website, channel or sample footage (optional URL field); (5) Timing as free text or neutral choices ('As soon as possible / Within a month or two / Flexible / Not sure') with no promised delivery times; (6) Budget as an optional free-text field ('Share a rough budget if you have one') - do NOT add price brackets, since no prices are approved; (7) Preferred contact method only if the owner approves phone/WhatsApp (owner decision); (8) A consent line linking to /privacy. Mark required fields visibly and with aria-required, and add a short hint under the message field (what to include). Consider a 2-3 step layout (You / Project / Details) so the longer form stays calm on mobile.
confirmed.note: DOM fields are exactly name, email, service, message. No element has required or aria-required, and there are no placeholders or hints. The suggested additions are sound provided budget and timing stay free-text or neutral with no brackets or promises. Treat the multi-step layout as optional; a single well-grouped form is enough.

confirmed.title: Page looks like an unstyled template: single narrow column, 160px dead gap, half the screen empty
confirmed.evidence: At 1440 the form occupies x=208-880 and the right ~45% of the page is empty flat #0c1024. Pull the form up so it starts above the fold (cut the gap to ~48px or merge the sections). Put the form on a light paper (#F6F7FC) card or section for contrast with the dark header. Replace the service select with three large studio choice cards using the division accents (aqua / violet / lilac, GROW tagged Beta), and style any remaining select with appearance-none plus a custom chevron.
confirmed.note: Measured at 1440x900: form spans x=208-880, form top at y=609, first input at y=641, gap between intro block and form 160px, select computed appearance 'auto' (native chevron). Both PageShell sections are #0c1024 (PageShell.tsx:5,12; the contact page does not pass 'light'). Screenshot verify-contact-1440-empty.png confirms the empty right half. Correction: only the Name field is fully above the fold; Email starts at y=747 and the select at y=853.

confirmed.title: Errors are not announced and focus is not managed
confirmed.evidence: After an empty submit: 0 elements with role=alert or aria-live in the document, and document.activeElement stays on the BUTTON (measured) - a screen-reader user hears nothing. After a successful submit the focused button is unmounted and focus drops to BODY; the role=status div is inserted already populated, which many screen readers do not announce. At 768 the first error ended up at y=97 only by luck of scroll position; nothing scrolls the first invalid field into view.
confirmed.fix: On failed validation, focus the first invalid field (and scroll it into view with scroll-margin for the fixed header) and render a role=alert summary above the form ('3 fields need attention') with links to each field. On result, move focus to the result heading (tabIndex=-1) and keep a persistent, initially empty live region that the message is written into.
confirmed.note: After empty submit: 0 elements with role=alert or aria-live, activeElement stays BUTTON. After valid submit activeElement is BODY. At 390x844 the submit button sits at y=1156 while the first error is at y=650, so a phone user who taps submit sees only the message error, with the name and email errors above the viewport and nothing scrolling to them.

confirmed.title: Errors do not clear when the visitor fixes the field

confirmed.title: Form is missing from server HTML (blank until JS hydrates)
confirmed.evidence: curl of /contact returns 0 occurrences of '<form' and contains BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING; with JavaScript disabled the page has no form at all (noJS.form = false). The main content of the page pops in after hydration with an empty hole before it.
confirmed.fix: Render the form on the server: read searchParams in the page (server component) and pass initial values as props, or at minimum give Suspense a skeleton fallback with the same dimensions. Add a <noscript> note.
confirmed.note: curl of /contact returns 0 occurrences of '<form' and contains BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING. With JavaScript disabled there is no form and no noscript element; the page shows only the heading, intro and footer. app/contact/page.tsx:9 uses Suspense fallback={null}. I would rate this major rather than minor: the page's only purpose is absent without JS, and a hole pops in on slow hydration.

confirmed.title: Validation is loose and inputs are unbounded
confirmed.evidence: Name 'X', email 'a@b.c' and message 'aaaaaaaaaa' pass and reach the result panel (junkAccepted = true). No maxlength on any field (0 elements with maxlength). Submit button has no explicit type attribute.

summary: Cross-cutting responsive + accessibility audit of the running build (BUILD_ID 01:28) at 360, 768 and 1024 px across the homepage and all 9 inner pages, using puppeteer measurements and screenshots saved in /Users/raghusai/Desktop/CLAUDE 2.0/MAKENDLESSNWEBSITE/docs/audit/tmp/ (prefix resp-a11y-; raw data in resp-a11y-measure.json, resp-a11y-behave.json, resp-a11y-extra.json). The base is solid (skip link, one h1 per page, visible focus on every control on dark sections, clean console, no document overflow on the homepage), but there are real breaks: sideways overflow on /contact, /build and /studios on phones, the Final CTA headline clipped at 360 and 768, the Studios cards broken at 768 (GROW Beta badge pushed off-screen), three of four tablists with no keyboard/ARIA wiring, reduced-motion ignored by three sections, and a focus ring that nearly disappears on light sections. Note: components/Nav.tsx, FinalCta.tsx, PageShell.tsx and app/globals.css were modified on disk at 01:50-01:51, after the running build, so some Nav/CTA findings may already be in progress in source; everything below was observed in the running build.
keep: Skip link ('Skip to content' -> #main) is the first Tab stop on every page and becomes visible on focus (138x40).

Document structure: lang=en, one <main>, one header, one footer, unique page titles, exactly one h1 per page, and the homepage heading order is clean (h1 > h2 per section > h3 > h4 for FAQ questions, no skipped levels).
Homepage has zero document-level horizontal overflow at 360, 768 and 1024, and exactly seven sections in spec order.

Visible focus exists on every one of the 58 Tab stops on the homepage (2px solid #22d3ee, offset 3px); the hero range correctly moves its ring to the visible track (.hero-track-ring). Tab order follows visual order with no traps.
Hero at 360x780: headline, supporting line and both CTAs fit above the fold (CTA bottoms at 396/398px, 48-50px tall); the mode tabs and timeline also fit (range bottom 768).

Hero 'Service mode' tablist: roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight work, aria-selected correct, 44px tall tabs, role=status on the RAW/EDITED state, aria-valuetext on the timeline slider, Pause/Play video button with aria-pressed.
Hero under prefers-reduced-motion: no canvas, still fallback, autoplay paused ('Play video'), mode cycling stopped, scroll-behavior auto.
Mobile menu at 360: 320x61px link rows, 52px CTA, aria-expanded/aria-controls on the toggle, 44x44 toggle; Escape closes it when focus is on the toggle.

Touch targets in the page body are good: all section tabs/pills are 44px tall, FAQ rows 64px, Request Quote links 64px tall, Solutions tabs 56px+, form fields 51-54px with 16px font (no iOS zoom), submit 56px.
FAQ accordion buttons sit inside headings with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at existing panels.
Muted text contrast is fine nearly everywhere: #a4aac7 on ink/surface and #5a6082 on paper all pass 4.5:1; only the specific cases listed in findings fail.
Console is clean on all 10 pages at all three widths (only a favicon 404 on first load).
Only Syne is used for text (330 sampled elements; one monospace timecode in the hero).
Recomposition at 360 is genuinely mobile-first in Studios (stacked full-width gateways with Beta badge visible), Solutions (2x2 selector), Packages (single column) and Process (vertical steps).
ownerTodos: Approve a favicon / app icon (a simple MAKENDLESS mark) since none exists and the browser requests one.
Decide whether the fifth website package (Maintenance) should stay as its own card; with five cards the grid needs a 3+2 or 2-column layout at tablet/laptop widths.
